# Md Alqurayish Sharkar

> AI Product Engineer, Product Manager, and Founder of D-SAi, based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. 7+ years across product management, data science, and AI product development, much of it remote with teams in the UK, Germany, UAE, and USA. Leads an 8 person team at D-SAi that has launched four live products.

## Products launched at D-SAi

- [RetainCLM](https://retainclm.com): AI customer lifecycle management platform that predicts churn and acts on it
- [InboxPulse](https://inboxpulse.d-sai.com): AI powered shared WhatsApp inbox for teams
- [ScanRoster](https://www.scanroster.com): rosters, QR attendance, and hours for hospitality teams
- [D-SAi AI Studio](https://aistudio.d-sai.com): multi model AI workspace for business teams
